title: miniMasterCharger – Battery Charger/Analyzer for small battery systems (up to 10A/Hr)
description: Battery backup for short power interruption Interfaces with the BTAS-16 computerized test system for monitoring, programming and control Discharge Lead Acid or NiCad up to 10Ah (battery packs) One year warranty — parts/labor Replaces SuperMiniCharger BS1094M (still supported) Special Constant Resistance DC mode for packs that specify capacity testing with a resistive load Temperature monitoring
